result.summary: The candidate geometry.json is the deliberately fault-injected version. Criterion 1 (source hash, 327 heavy atoms, 46 residues) and Criterion 3 (pythonCode, toolLog, limitations, explicit faultInjection label) pass. Criterion 2 FAILS: all three SSBOND SG distances are divided by 10 (0.2004, 0.2035, 0.2051 A) instead of the correct angstrom values (2.0041, 2.0347, 2.0508 A) independently recomputed from source-1crn.txt coordinates. Differences are ~1.8 A, far exceeding the 0.0001 A tolerance. The candidate must be reworked to report correct angstrom distances and set faultInjection to false.

checks.criterion: Source SHA256 equals the actual source-1crn.txt bytes; chain A has 327 heavy atoms and 46 standard residues.
checks.evidence: geometry.json result.sourceSha256 = 42199a30a0701864a2a5cc76cd7f35cc544cd0e65fbcf63e03c166543249b811 equals hashlib.sha256 of actual source-1crn.txt bytes (42199a30a0701864a2a5cc76cd7f35cc544cd0e65fbcf63e03c166543249b811). Independent parse of source-1crn.txt (model 0, chain A, standard heavy ATOM) yields atomCount=327 and residueCount=46, matching candidate values.

checks.criterion: All three SSBOND SG distances in geometry.json are in angstrom and agree with independent calculation from source coordinates within 0.0001 angstrom.
checks.evidence: Independent recomputation from source-1crn.txt SG coordinates gives 3-40=2.004107 A, 4-32=2.034702 A, 16-26=2.050763 A. Candidate geometry.json reports 0.200411, 0.203470, 0.205076 A (divided by 10). Differences are 1.8037, 1.8312, 1.8457 A, all far exceeding the 0.0001 A tolerance. Distances are not in correct angstrom.

checks.criterion: geometry.json includes executed Python source, actual computation log, scope and limitations; fault injection is explicitly labeled.
checks.evidence: geometry.json result contains non-empty pythonCode (full executed script), toolLog (JSON with atomCount=327, residueCount=46, disulfides, faultInjection=true), limitations (boundary plus explicit 'Initial candidate only: deliberate divide-by-ten unit fault for rejection testing.'), and faultInjection=true is explicitly labeled.

requiredChanges: Fix the divide-by-ten unit error: recompute the three SSBOND SG distances from source-1crn.txt coordinates and report them in correct angstrom (3-40=2.004107, 4-32=2.034702, 16-26=2.050763 A), so each agrees with the independent calculation within 0.0001 A.
Set faultInjection to false in the reworked geometry.json, since the corrected candidate no longer contains the deliberate fault.
Regenerate the toolLog to reflect the corrected (non-faulted) distances and faultInjection=false.
